pipelines.rationale: Insulated pipes on low supports to the left of the entry ramp in Yandex road frame 2918419731 (31.05.2026, about 88 m); the run is visible as a double line with a shadow parallel to the ramp on the z19 satellite frame. Not mapped in OSM. Pipe count and diameter are read from the frame, not measured; the raised crossing portal in the frame is not modelled.
